description: Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions and 30 formats in all. Blueprints let a team share rules with variables, and a CLI and a VS Code extension put the files into every project.
